description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single-target Earth/NE magical attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [MAG & MND +50% (25s)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Earth Resonance 5% Boost], & Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Maria v2) to the user
Dual Awoken Earth Mode I: Earth Ability Boost, Triplecast Earth & chases Earth abilities with 4 single-target Earth/NE magic attacks (2.04 each) (max 3 chases)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text:
Grants [Instant ATB 1] and Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Maria v2)
Dual Awoken Earth Mode II: Earth Ability Boost, Instant Earth & chases an Earth ability with [Earth Ability Damage +30%] & [Damage Cap +10000] for 3 turns to user
